_meta.note: Same event-card format as events_act2.json plus scenario and role tags. Every scenario has trigger, decoy, winner cards (S1/S2/S3 winners; S0 has one gentle winner).

event_cards.title: A Softer Quote
event_cards.body: Your broker says two hyperscaler RFPs closed at rates a shade under last year's. Nobody is panicking; everyone is 'checking the model.'
event_cards.basis: Designed: GPU 1yr index drifts -8% by 2027Q4 in market_s0.csv

event_cards.title: Spreads Blink
event_cards.body: A lender pulls a $600M deal, and DDTL spreads jump 200bp in a week. By Friday, two others quietly close at the old price. It looks like a signal. It may be noise.

choices.label: Refinance now at the wider spread
Draw down the revolver as insurance

event_cards.basis: Designed decoy: LS spikes to 67 latent then reverts by 2028Q2 (signals_s0.json)

event_cards.title: The Digestion Quarter
event_cards.body: Two of the biggest cloud buyers say they will digest capacity already contracted. The first big neocloud master lease comes up: same tenant, same GPUs, 20-30% off shell rent and a two-year-longer ask. Not a crisis. Just the market.

event_cards.title: Everyone Reads the Same Report
event_cards.body: An analyst note says the reset was 'fully priced.' Your lender agrees; your tenant's CFO nods along. You feel oddly relieved.

event_cards.title: The Halving Trims the Miners
event_cards.body: Block subsidy halves again. Your older ASICs are underwater unless power is cheap. Most of the market saw it coming.

event_cards.title: A Good Year For Boring
event_cards.body: Your hedged sites collect the same rent for the fifth quarter running. The other players are still arguing about 2027.
event_cards.basis: Designed winner card: rewards the hedged player modestly

event_cards.title: A Cheaper Chip for Everyone
event_cards.body: Rubin supply loosens. Hopper rent falls again. Old fleets earn less; new fleets are easier to fill.

event_cards.title: Feynman Whispers
event_cards.body: A trade blog says the next generation is 'a step change.' Rubin resale wobbles 3%.

event_cards.title: Your Lender Asks About Concentration
event_cards.body: A credit officer asks how much of your rent comes from one tenant. Politely. Twice. It is on the agenda for the annual review.

event_cards.title: Chips Suddenly Scarce
event_cards.body: New-generation racks are 30 weeks out and every neocloud is on the phone. You read it as demand. It could be a supply hiccup at one packager.
event_cards.basis: Designed decoy: CLT latent 50->76 then collapses to 21-23 in 2028Q2 (signals_s1.json)

event_cards.title: The Round That Didn't Close
event_cards.body: An anchor AI lab's funding round fails to close and it misses two payments, citing financing conditions. Its sub-tenants are being called by lenders. Cap rates gap 100bp in a month.

choices.label: Renegotiate now: take a haircut to keep the tenant
Buy the debt at a discount (if cash)

event_cards.default: Renegotiate now: take a haircut to keep the tenant
event_cards.basis: Motivated by Oracle force majeure (2026-09-25, Act II) and DDTL spread widening

event_cards.title: Refinancing Window Closes
event_cards.body: Your DDTL matures in two quarters. New quotes are +250bp and 60% advance rate.

event_cards.title: The Backstop Was Real
event_cards.body: A hyperscaler that guaranteed your tenant's lease pays out. You are made whole. The guarantee cost you 5% of the company two years ago.

event_cards.title: Distressed Sites Go To Auction
event_cards.body: A leveraged rival's 60MW site goes under the hammer at $3M/MW. Stabilised EV/MW is down 55%.

event_cards.title: Tenant Default Notice
event_cards.body: A sub-tenant defaults on 30MW. Your take-or-pay claim is only as good as its parent.

event_cards.title: Chips Are Cheap Now
event_cards.body: Rubin racks trade at a 40% discount to 2027 list. The survivors are buying.

event_cards.title: The Grid Is Nervous
event_cards.body: The RTO's reserve-margin forecast just got worse. Load studies show your peers' interconnection requests doubling. Time to lock in energized MW.

event_cards.title: Efficiency Papers Everywhere
event_cards.body: Three labs publish 'do more with less' results in a week. Your GPU vendor's shares dip 8%. Is demand cracking?
event_cards.basis: Designed decoy: EI peaks 78, then falls; DeepSeek precedent (Jan 2025, Act II ec13)

event_cards.title: Compute Is Strategic
event_cards.body: Hyperscaler capex is guided up 35% and every energized MW is spoken for. The queue is five years. Spot prices explode; your renewals hold flat.

choices.label: Sign a 10-yr lock with your best tenant
Go to spot on uncontracted MW

event_cards.default: Sign a 10-yr lock with your best tenant

event_cards.title: The Winners' Curse
event_cards.body: A rival announces a $12B campus. Analysts note that the winner of last year's bidding is now paying 40% more for turbines.

event_cards.title: Nuclear Restart Pays
event_cards.body: Your fixed-price PPA looks like a gift as PJM power triples.

event_cards.title: Ratepayers Push Back
event_cards.body: Bills are up 30% in your region. A moratorium bill has 12 co-sponsors.

event_cards.title: New-Contract Premium
event_cards.body: New RFPs are clearing at +30%. Your old locked contracts look cheap. Tenants want to renew early and stay.

event_cards.title: Too Good To Last?
event_cards.body: Headlines say 'no bubble.' Your lender asks what you would do if it did.

event_cards.title: Benchmarks Look Wrong
event_cards.body: A new model matches frontier scores on one-tenth the compute. Engineers you know are quietly rewriting their capacity plans.

event_cards.title: Grid Margin Collapses
event_cards.body: A heat wave drops your reserve margin to 4%. Utilities warn of curtailment. It looks like scarcity. It is a weather week.
event_cards.basis: Designed decoy: GRM trough 33 then reverts (signals_s3.json)

event_cards.title: Open-Weights Week
event_cards.body: A lab releases open weights matching frontier scores on one-tenth the GPUs. Chip lead times collapse from 18 to 6 weeks and hyperscalers cut capex 30%.

choices.label: Ask tenants to reopen for shorter terms

event_cards.title: The Reopener
event_cards.body: Your tenant's contract has a market-reopener clause. They are using it.

event_cards.title: Jevons Returns
event_cards.body: Cheaper inference brings more use. AI demand index climbs 8 points in a quarter.

event_cards.title: Flexible Is King
event_cards.body: Your short-term contracts re-let within a month at the new price; long-locked neighbours are still stuck.

event_cards.title: Chip Glut
event_cards.body: Rubin racks are 30% off list. Inventories are heavy.

event_cards.title: Everyone Runs Small Models
event_cards.body: Edge inference is real. Regional sites near cities gain a small edge premium.

event_cards.title: Act III Opens
event_cards.body: The easy money is behind you. Your tenants are asking about 2028; your lenders are asking about 2027. Nobody can tell you what the market will do. Read the signals.

event_cards.title: Nuclear Offer
event_cards.body: A restarted reactor's owner offers a 15-year fixed PPA. No queue. Take-or-pay.

event_cards.title: Government Affairs Recruiter Calls
event_cards.body: A seasoned former commission aide is available.

event_cards.title: Rubin Ultra Preview
event_cards.body: The 600 kW rack is real. Existing halls cannot host it without a rebuild.

event_cards.title: The Reckoning Ends
event_cards.body: Four years of contracts and headlines. Time to see who read the market.
